shortDescription: Saudi Arabia, Turkey and Pakistan agreed to establish a secretariat in Saudi Arabia under their Mecca joint defence agreement, which will initially be headed by a Pakistani secretary-general for three years, Saudi Arabia's foreign ministry said in a statement on Monday.
